parameters.name: BackupDbNames
parameters.description: If you need to back up data at the database level, you must specify the list of databases to be backed up, and separate multiple databases with commas (,).

parameters.name: BackupLevel
parameters.description:
The backup level. Valid values:

*   instance: instance
*   db: The database type.

parameters.name: BackupMode
parameters.description:
The backup mode. For more information, see [backup mode](~~108631~~) and the valid values are as follows:

*   phy: fast backup
*   logic: Consistent backup

parameters.name: DrdsInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the DRDS instance.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun drds put-start-backup --drds-instance-id drds0000c6vxxyzd --backup-mode phy --backup-level db --backup-db-names db_1,_db_2 --api-version 2019-01-23 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun drds PutStartBackup --region cn-hangzhou --DrdsInstanceId drds0000c6vxxyzd --BackupMode phy --BackupLevel db --BackupDbNames 'db_1,_db_2'
